sentences.text:
For the Informant: Mr. Lakhan Chandra Roy, Advocate ---
04 / 15.05.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Deoghar Town P.S. Case No. 425 of 2018 for the offences registered under sections 341, 323, 307, 376 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code and section 3 / 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Deoghar.
3. Petitioner is the husband of the Informant.
It is alleged that after the marriage, there was demand of dowry and to enforce the demand, informant was tortured and ultimately, she was driven away from her matrimonial home.
4. It appears that the petitioner was earlier released on anticipatory bail on the ground that he will receive back the Informant to her matrimonial home and will maintain her.
it appears that again some dispute arose, due to which, Informant was forced to leave her matrimonial home.

5. It was submitted that though, case has also been instituted under sections 307 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, but the learned court below at the time of framing of charge, has discharged the petitinoer under these sections.

It was submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 25.12.2023 and he is ready to pay the complainant the maintenance amount within three months from the date Kuldeep Khaware @ Pintu Ji vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184888201/
1 of his release.

entities.text: Kuldeep Khaware @ Pintu Ji vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Considering the aforesaid facts, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Deoghar in connection with Deoghar Town P.S. Case No. 425 of 2018.
